code:
exec(open("work/lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

res,order=parse_pdb("work/AF-P38213.pdb")
o=[r for r in order if 548<=r[1]<=731]
CA=np.array([res[r]['atoms']['CA'] for r in o]); nums=np.array([r[1] for r in o])
gp=np.load("work/dsf2_groove_pts.npy")
face=set(int(x[0]) if not isinstance(x,(int,float)) else int(x) for x in
         [f[0] if isinstance(f,(list,tuple)) else f for f in json.load(open("work/concave.json"))['DSF2 548-731']['face']])

resH,orderH=parse_pdb("work/1OUV.pdb",chain="A")
CAH=np.array([resH[r]['atoms']['CA'] for r in orderH])

probe=CA[(nums>=643)&(nums<=717)]
best=(99.,0)
for i in range(len(CAH)-len(probe)+1):
    r=rmsd_after(probe,CAH[i:i+len(probe)])
    if r<best[0]: best=(r,i)
rms,i0=best
ref=CAH[i0:i0+len(probe)]
CAd=apply_sup(probe,ref,CA)

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,4.8))
ax=fig.add_subplot(131,projection='3d')
ax.plot(CAH[:,0],CAH[:,1],CAH[:,2],color="#9aa0a6",lw=1.3,label="HcpC 1OUV chain A")
ax.plot(CAd[:,0],CAd[:,1],CAd[:,2],color="#1f4e79",lw=2.0,label="DSF2 548-731 (AlphaFold v6)")
ax.set_title(f"DSF2 repeats 643-717 superposed on HcpC\ngapless CA RMSD {rms:.2f} A over {len(probe)} residues",fontsize=9)
ax.legend(fontsize=7,loc="upper left"); ax.set_axis_off()

ax=fig.add_subplot(132,projection='3d')
isface=np.isin(nums,sorted(face))
ax.plot(CA[:,0],CA[:,1],CA[:,2],color="#c9ccd1",lw=1.1)
ax.scatter(CA[isface,0],CA[isface,1],CA[isface,2],c="#d62828",s=16,label="concave-face residues")
ax.scatter(CA[~isface,0],CA[~isface,1],CA[~isface,2],c="#1f4e79",s=8,label="other")
ax.scatter(gp[:,0],gp[:,1],gp[:,2],c="#2a9d8f",s=4,alpha=.3,label="largest groove (295 A3)")
ax.set_title("DSF2 model: the largest groove sits off the\nconcave repeat face, at the C-terminal cap",fontsize=9)
ax.legend(fontsize=6.5,loc="upper left"); ax.set_axis_off()

ax=fig.add_subplot(133)
rows=[("Hrd3 220-480 (Sel1L-like)",1439,1.2,"other Sel1"),
      ("Hop TPR2A (true MEEVD site)",567,1.2,"positive control"),
      ("HcpB 1KLX",410,1.2,"other Sel1"),
      ("HcpC 1OUV",399,1.2,"other Sel1"),
      ("DSF2 548-731",295,1.2,"DSF2"),
      ("Myoglobin 1MBN",272,1.4,"negative control"),
      ("PP5 TPR 1A17",225,1.4,"other TPR"),
      ("DSF2 643-731 (regular SLR)",143,1.2,"DSF2")]
cols={"DSF2":"#d62828","positive control":"#2a9d8f","negative control":"#9aa0a6","other Sel1":"#1f4e79","other TPR":"#6f9fd8"}
y=np.arange(len(rows))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,[r[1] for r in rows],color=[cols[r[3]] for r in rows])
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([r[0] for r in rows],fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xlabel("largest concave groove volume (A$^3$)")
ax.set_title("Same detector, 100% MEEVD atom recall on 1ELR",fontsize=9)
ax.grid(axis="x",alpha=.3); ax.set_xlim(0,1650)
for k,r in enumerate(rows):
    ax.text(r[1]+25,y[k],f"{r[1]}"+("*" if r[2]==1.4 else ""),va="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax.text(0.98,0.02,"* coarser grid (1.4 A)",transform=ax.transAxes,ha="right",fontsize=6.5,color="#555")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["structure","groove_volume_A3","grid_A","class"])
df["extent_A"]=["16.0 x 8.3 x 5.2","12.5 x 7.0 x 3.5","13.8 x 10.9 x 4.0","21.9 x 9.0 x 3.8",
                "13.2 x 8.9 x 2.1","9.9 x 7.7 x 3.2","6.6 x 4.4 x 2.2","8.9 x 4.6 x 1.8"]
df["n_lining"]=[68,41,37,44,32,None,None,19]
df.to_csv("work/groove_geometry.csv",index=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))

t=cKDTree(gp)
lin=[int(n) for k,n in enumerate(nums) if t.query_ball_point(CA[k],8.0)]
def unit(n): return "R1 563-598" if n<=598 else "R2 599-642" if n<=642 else "R3 643-680" if n<=680 else "R4 681-721" if n<=721 else "C-cap 722-731"
c=collections.Counter(unit(n) for n in lin)
print("\nlining residues (CA within 8 A of groove):",len(lin),"span",min(lin),"-",max(lin))
print(dict(c))
print("fraction in R4 + C-cap:",round(sum(v for k,v in c.items() if k.startswith(("R4","C-cap")))/len(lin),2))
print("fraction of lining on concave face:",round(np.isin(lin,sorted(face)).mean(),2))
